historical_observations.routerbench: historical prompts/IDs/split; no labels in requests
historical_observations.azure: only first N arrival_s gap shape; no RouterBench real arrival pairing
historical_observations.train_output_lengths: historical regex proxy lengths; aggregate task x model from train only

residual_noise.same_shock_for: TTFT/decode/S/L/regions/strategies of the same request and rep
residual_noise.prediction_uses: mean one; realized shock must not be exposed to scheduler before service

inherited_task2_assumptions.queue_assumption: Task2 separate nonbatched FCFS S/L pools; no queues constructed here
inherited_task2_assumptions.controller_energy_formula: router_seconds*requests*incremental_w*PUE/3.6e6; final route has no Post checks
inherited_task2_assumptions.source_code: Work 1\task1_response time, and environ mental impact\core.py

time_alignment.note: Keep baseline; align by translation only after real actual carbon data is provided

precheck.capacity_loss_semantics: external unavailability; no extra jobs injected; no automatic power-off

task3_new_assumptions.classes_independent_of: task/quality/actual output; shuffled exact quotas with separate RNG
task3_new_assumptions.origin_region: uniform independent simulated metadata, no historical origin inference
task3_new_assumptions.regional_capacity: 1 replica per model per region; total 3 S + 3 L, versus Task2 1+1 primary; all strategies share identical resources
task3_new_assumptions.availability_semantics: piecewise constant from event timestamp, persists to next event; default no outage; no automatic pool increase
task3_new_assumptions.prediction_method: rounded mean output proxy by task/model from train only; plug into inherited equations, not a fitted Pre model
task3_new_assumptions.prediction_limit: plug-in estimate ignores output variance and is not a calibrated service-time distribution
task3_new_assumptions.estimated_energy_scope: marginal facility busy-over-idle kWh, excludes idle base/controller/network; do not use as total facility energy
task3_new_assumptions.network_semantics: one-way ingress transfer per request; fixed energy proxy; add inherited 0.05s control separately only once
task3_new_assumptions.service_multiplier_semantics: request estimate already includes S/L multiplier; regional multiplier is reference metadata, do not multiply twice
task3_new_assumptions.arrival_span_compatibility: recomputed from prospective L estimate, not current test output; same Azure shape and permutation as Task2
task3_new_assumptions.absolute_time_anchor: synthetic UTC date aligned with historical Azure day; configurable before real carbon experiments

precheck.uncertainty: deterministic prior estimates only; stochastic overruns not guaranteed
precheck.capacity_semantics: positive capacity must persist through isolated nonpreemptive service; no assumption about actual in-flight cancellation
precheck.sample_scope: all region subsets, sampled windows only; passing does not prove all capacity inequalities

fair_comparison.resources: same server_config/network_config/server_availability and rep for every policy
fair_comparison.randomness: lookup service_random_conditions by request_id,rep; never draw by processing order
fair_comparison.energy_window: choose common observation horizon after all compared runs; charge all idle pools
fair_comparison.regional_expansion: shared six replicas for every policy; no policy-exclusive servers

carbon.decision_inputs: forecasts with issued_at_utc <= decision time only
carbon.coverage_required: all DE/FR/ES hours from min arrival.floor(hour) to max completion deadline.floor(hour); later overruns need more coverage
carbon.availability_means: file_present_only; validation_report records schema and coverage validation
carbon.schema: CO2 -> carbon_intensity_gco2_kwh and gCO2/kWh; CO2e -> carbon_intensity_gco2e_kwh and gCO2e/kWh; mandatory matching species/methodology
